# Brain Rush

> Free browser game by Liz for 60-second mental-math drills and English↔Chinese word reaction practice. Local scores and mistake book; no account required.

## Product

- What: educational reaction game (口算 + vocabulary)
- Modes: 60s timed quick start; advanced practice tuning (ops, ranges, remainders, negatives); word 中英互译
- Data: scores, mistakes, and settings stay in the local browser
- Maker: Liz
- Price: free
